title: Section-normalized completed module direct-image identity
statement: Let $A$ have adic datum $d$ [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum]. For a scheme $T$ use its actual completed ring sheaf and ordinary module direct image [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations]. Define $a:(1_T)_*\simeq1$ to be the unique module isomorphism whose component on a module $M$, at a test object $U$, is $M$ applied to the inverse of the canonical pullback-identity isomorphism at $U$. This is the published modulePushId; its section normalization fixes the identity-open adjunction comparison.
